commands.help.tip: Lists every command, or shows how to use one
commands.toggle.tip: Switches a module on or off
commands.set.tip: Changes one of a module's settings
commands.get.tip: Shows a module's settings, or one of them
commands.bind.tip: Binds a module's switch to a key or mouse button
commands.profile.tip: Shows or changes which modules may run
commands.prefix.tip: Shows or changes what a command line starts with
commands.seedcheck.tip: Compares %s's prediction with the blocks around you
commands.cracker.tip: %s: what it has, forget it all, search again, what to look for, or which side of a bedrock conflict to trust
commands.say.tip: Sends the text as chat, for a line that has to start with the prefix
commands.modules.tip: Lists the modules, the ones switched on marked
commands.goto.tip: Walks to a block, or to where the freecam is, drawing the route; ~ is relative to your feet
commands.mine.tip: Switches %1$s on with its %2$s list, or for one ore family, logs, wood or one block this run, mining count blocks when given; stop switches it off
commands.follow.tip: Walks after a player in sight until they leave it; on its own, stops
commands.friend.tip: Lists, adds or removes friends; combat modules leave friends alone unless Attack friends is on
commands.nbt.tip: Reads or edits the held item's components in creative, as in [custom_name='Name',!lore]
